deploy-bot: Starting image push for service/api:v3.7.1 -> registry.redwood.ai/prod/service/api:v3.7.1
deploy-bot: build sha=sha256:0a1b2c3d started by @jin in change window (2026-03-19T14:20Z)
jin: on it, running canary push to eu-west first. tagging and signing step next.
lara: noted, keep canary off prod until manifest signed + arm64 verified.
deploy-bot: pushing manifest list and amd64 layers... amd64 completed, manifest signed by sig-proxy v1.2.
registry-bot: manifesto signed: manifest-sha=sha256:4f5e6d7c, signature-id=sig-20260319-01
marco: seeing intermittent 502s from registry for the arm64 layer upload. retrying with backoff.
jin: paste of failing chunk:
```
error: failed to upload layer: Put https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/prod/service/blobs/uploads/: net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)
```
kat: can we mirror to fallback bucket/registry and then update manifest? worried about partial availability during canary.
marco: tried mirror->s3-bk, mirror upload succeeded but registry returned 409 on finalize (digest mismatch).
jin: decision time — option A wait and keep window, B pin manifest to existing amd64-only digest and abort arm64 for now, C rollback release.
lara: we can't block customer traffic; prefer B (pin to digest that has full amd64 manifest) and mark arm64 as deferred. open a follow-up ticket to re-push arm64 outside change window.
deploy-bot: rolling forward with pin: pinned_digest=sha256:4f5e6d7c; canary promoted to eu-west with amd64-only image. arm64 artifact will be reattempted on next patch.
registry-bot: tag update: prod/service/api:v3.7.1 -> digest sha256:4f5e6d7c (arm64 missing)
jin: adding release note: "v3.7.1: canary deployed (amd64). arm64 artifacts deferred due to registry layer failures; re-push scheduled."
lara: good. tagging release notes and notifying support. marking incident: infra-registries-2026-03-19 in postmortem queue.
marco: will follow up with registry provider logs and escalate if 502s continue.
kat: thanks — will update CHANGELOG and the rollout doc to say arm64 will be available in v3.7.1-patch.
jin: any objections to keeping the prod traffic on pinned digest?
lara: none. proceed. :thumbsup:
